findings.title: The test can assert success before the reader finishes
findings.body: The reader thread is started but never joined. After the deleter sets `deletedAll`, the main thread can assert that `caughtExceptions` is empty while the reader is still handling an in-flight request; an exception from that request can therefore arrive after the assertion and the test still passes. Join the reader before asserting so the regression test reliably observes failures from the full concurrent-read interval.
